CustomField.description: Shows the running user each step the agent takes (for example Looking up information) while a reply is being prepared. Set at user, profile or organisation level. Step names only - request and response content is governed separately by the per-user Debug Mode Enabled setting.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Tick to show users live progress steps while they wait. This never shows request or response content; that needs Debug Mode on the user.
CustomField.label: Should Show Execution Trace
